title: ubutyebi obatshona phantsi kwekratshi
intro: Khawuthelekelele ume phambi kweemfumba zobutyebi obuninzi kangangokuba ukuphatha nje izitshixo kuya kudinisa iqela labantu abanamandla. Abantu abakungqongileyo bakhuthaza ukuthobeka nokukhumbula, kodwa ikratshi likhula ngaphezu kombulelo. Kwenzeka ntoni xa intsikelelo iba luvavanyo kwaye ikratshi livala isiphumo?
clues: Ndanikwa ubutyebi obukhulu kangangokuba izitshixo zabo zaziza kuba nzima kwiqela lamadoda anamandla.
Ndicetyiswe ngabantu bam ukuba ndingavuyi kwaye ndifune ubomi obuzayo ngaphandle kokulibala isabelo sam kweli hlabathi.
Ndathi into endandinayo ndiyinikwe ngenxa yolwazi endandinalo.
Ndahamba phambi kwabantu bam ndinxibe izivatho, abo banqwenela ubomi behlabathi banqwenela into efana neyam.
Ndaginywa ngumhlaba kunye nendawo yam yokuhlala, kwaye akukho mntu wayenokundinceda kwaye nam ndandingenakuzinceda.

options: Wayeqhayisa ngobutyebi waza wala ububele buka-Allah nangona wayecebiswa
Wacela umngeni u-Ibrahim malunga nokunikela ubomi nokufa

outcome.label: Isiphumo

Watshatyalaliswa kukuqhuma okukhulu ngenxa yokubetha ikamela eliyimazi
Uguqulwe waba yinkawu ngenxa yokuphula iSabatha

arabic: فَخَسَفْنَا بِهِۦ وَبِدَارِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَمَا كَانَ لَهُۥ مِن فِئَةٍۢ يَنصُرُونَهُۥ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنتَصِرِينَ
verse: And We caused the earth to swallow him and his home. And there was for him no company to aid him other than Allāh, nor was he of those who [could] defend themselves. (28:81)
